summary: Frontend-only verification of (1) My Projects 'View items' expander and (2) Storyboard Studio media manufacturing (verified KR + 5-output pilot + unverified KR Knowledge-First gating). All 6 acceptance criteria pass.

issues: React hydration console warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> on data-testid='storyboard-kr'. Root cause: emergent editor's data-ve-dynamic wrapper injects a <span style=display:contents> around the option's text expression at build/runtime. Browsers strip the <span> inside <option>, so functionality is unaffected, but a console error is logged on every page mount. Not authored in StoryboardStudio.js source (line 70 renders plain text). Cosmetic/console-only.

critical_code_review_comments: ProjectsContinuity.js line 32 uses a bare `catch {}` — losing the error; consider `catch (e) { console.error(e); toast.error(...) }` for observability.

StoryboardStudio.js option text is plain, but emergent editor injects a <span> wrapper that violates HTML nesting — if this warning must be silenced, dropdowns could be replaced with a custom listbox / shadcn Select to avoid <option> children rules.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing verified KR 'What Is Governance?' (KMR-1A93CE) and unverified KR 'What Is Architecture?' (KMR-1569B2).

Hydration warning on storyboard-kr is a benign emergent-editor injection.
